nothing: the message is the instruction data.

fields.name: cluster_tag
docs: Genesis hash of the cluster; binds signed objects.

fields.name: split_mode
docs: 0 = the treasury half of a split goes to the treasury; 1 = burned.

types.name: ConfigChanged
docs: with the values after the change (`admin` is the default key once frozen).

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 website, 1 email, 2 Matrix, 3 Discord, 4 Telegram, 5 blob endpoint URL (HTTPS), 255 other.

fields.name: txid
docs: Zeros when no evidence was required.

types.name: EthBoard
docs: PDA `["eth_board", maker PDA]`, 1,408 bytes. Ethereum quotes published for discovery; opaque

fields.name: quote
docs: The compact form of SPEC 2.10. Dynamic fields: `tierPrice` at 102..150, `validUntil` at

types.name: Evidence
docs: The opening of a notice commitment, posted in clear.

fields.name: min_seq
docs: 0 = no check; ignored with a quote.

fields.name: key_hint
docs: Preferred pool slot; only a hint.

fields.name: approval_ix
docs: Index of the Ed25519 instruction carrying an advance approval.

types.name: Maker
docs: PDA `["maker", owner]`, 1,280 bytes. Fixed fields first; variable data last.

fields.name: owner
docs: Offset 8. Cold key: registration, link, payout, operator.

fields.name: operator
docs: Offset 40. Hot key: offers, approvals, notices, claims, messages.

fields.name: payout
docs: Offset 72. Wallet that receives direction-A claims (tokens: its associated token account).

fields.name: paused
docs: bit 0 set by the owner, bit 1 by the operator; nonzero = no new swaps.

fields.name: inbox_policy
docs: 0 = open; 1 = only takers with a swap (enforced by the daemon).

fields.name: eth_link
docs: Linked Ethereum maker address; zeros = none.

fields.name: eth_link_next
docs: Pending change and when it takes effect; 0 = none.

fields.name: onion
docs: v3 onion host (at most 62 bytes), or empty.

fields.name: valid_secs
docs: The offer is live while `now <= updated_at + valid_secs`.

types.name: Quote
docs: PDA `["quote", maker PDA, quote_id (u64 LE)]`, 192 bytes. A taker-bound quote, consumed and

fields.name: amount
docs: Exact: in A the taker pays `amount`, in B the maker escrows it.

fields.name: maker_pok
docs: Direction A: proof of knowledge, `ctx` = maker PDA.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: At most 120 s after posting; valid while `now <= expires_at`.

types.name: Swap
docs: PDA `["swap", taker, swap_nonce[16]]`, 736 bytes. Offsets in comments are frozen.

fields.name: mode
docs: 75. Effective mode: 0 auto, 1 window, 2 advance, 3 quote.

fields.name: deposit_state
docs: 77. 0 none, 1 held, 2 withheld, 3 returned, 4 released by the maker, 5 split.

fields.name: flags
docs: 79. bit 0 notice on record; bit 1 evidence published; bit 2 secret revealed; bit 3 the
revealer was the locker; bit 4 late notice (direction B).

fields.name: maker_enc_version
docs: 162. Maker key version the swap's messages use.

fields.name: maker_enc_key
docs: 166. The maker's X25519 key of that version, copied from the Maker account.

fields.name: locker_view
docs: 310. The locker's private view share, in clear.
